catalog_quote: (8) San'ani stress algorithm (a) Stress the rightmost non-final CVV or CVG syllable. Examples: makātib 'offices', ... ṣābūn 'soap', xārijīn 'going out m.pl.', ... musajjilatī 'my recorder', hākaḏahā 'like this', sāfart 'I/you m.s. travelled', dawwart 'I/you m.s. looked for'. (b) Otherwise stress a final CVVC/CVCC syllable. Examples: darast 'I/you m.s. learnt', ʔabsart 'I/you m.s. saw', gambart 'I/you m.s. sat', ... banāt 'girls'. (c) Otherwise stress the rightmost non-final CVC syllable up to the antepenultimate. Examples: laflaf 'he collected', maklaf 'woman', madrasih 'school', maklafih 'his woman' (d) Otherwise stress the leftmost CV syllable. Examples: katab 'he wrote', darasat 'she learnt', ragabatih 'his neck', maktabatī 'my library'. (e) Stress final CVV in disyllabic adjectives or di- or trisyllabic verbs in the imperfect. Examples: yifʕalū 'they m. do', ṭarī 'fresh'. In contras…

audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding quotation (Watson 2002 algorithm (8), clauses a-e) is verbatim in the held archive.org PDF at book p. 82, sec. 5.1.2; the secondary-stress and fluctuation quotations are also confirmed (p. 119, pp. 82-83). (2) Deciding source is a 2002 OUP phonology monograph with a 40-page word-stress chapter by the leading San'ani fieldworker; nothing in Glottolog's list (syntax 1993, pedagogical grammar 1992, Rossi 1939, Naïm 2009, a 16-pp 1990 article, sketches of other Yemeni dialects) outranks it for stress, and Crossref shows no instrumental San'ani word-stress study. (3) fetched sources Rossi 1939 from archive.org with record): sec. 12 p. 8 gives a quantity-sensitive rule (long = long vowel or closed syllable; penult if heavy else antepenult; final long in disyllables) plus the 'rules are not absolute

sources.quote: 'L'accento nel ṣanʿānī tende a ritirarsi verso l'inizio del vocabolo. Nei bisillabi l'accento sta sull'ultima sillaba se questa è lunga e la penultima è breve; diversamente sta sulla penultima ... Nei trisillabi l'accento sta sulla terzultima sillaba se la penultima è breve, sulla penultima se questa è lunga ... Nota 2. La sillaba è lunga quando ha vocale lunga o quando ha vocale breve seguita da due consonanti. Nota 3. Le regole suesposte dell'accento non sono assolute.
